name: The Ritz-Carlton Dove Mountain
positioning: The Ritz-Carlton, Dove Mountain: a Sonoran Desert resort in a canyon setting near Tucson, with Jack Nicklaus Signature golf, a spa and a family pool with a water slide
best_for: Golfers who want Jack Nicklaus Signature courses on site
Families who want a kids program, a water slide and casita suites
Guests who like guided desert hikes and stargazing

facts.text: The resort is 40 minutes from Tucson International Airport.
The resort sits in the Sonoran Desert in a canyon setting.
The Golf Club at Dove Mountain was for six years the home of the PGA Tour's WGC Accenture Match Play Championship.
Turquesa Latin Grill looks over the resort's infinity edge swimming pool, and its name is Spanish for turquoise.
Cayton's Restaurant serves Territorial Ranch Cuisine including fire-kissed steaks and buttermilk quail.
Ritz Kids sessions for resort guests ages 5 through 12 focus on life in Southern Arizona.
Guests can reserve private or group guided hikes in the Sonoran Desert and Tortolita Preserve, such as a Cactus Discovery or Ancient Art Hike.
The resort offers stargazing beneath a certified dark sky.
Rooms use indigenous textiles, natural materials and desert earth tones, with terraces that have canyon and mountain views.
The daily resort charge includes a guided morning nature walk, bike rentals with helmets and morning wellness classes.

highlights.text: The spa's holistic treatments use indigenous gemstones to ease muscles and restore balance.
A Native American flautist plays traditional songs on Ignite's patio each day at sunset.
The family-friendly Aventura Pool has a water slide and is connected to a children's splash pad.
The Golf Club at Dove Mountain has three nine-hole Jack Nicklaus Signature courses named Wild Burro, Saguaro and Tortolita.
The Casita Village offers Casita Suites and Private Casitas with spacious patios and panoramic canyon views.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the remote desert location requires transportation to Tucson attractions.
Valet parking is required at $44 per night.
The resort is in a dry climate and asks guests to stay hydrated.
